title: Run final Foundation build/start/test/smoke and compatibility gate

gates.name: Clean Foundation build and host tests

verify: From a clean/reset state, rerun the recorded build and host-test commands, install the produced APK and use the exact launch invocation recorded by TASK-001.

Exercise the Foundation smoke path: clean launch, stable fullscreen main display, local settings seed, start/cancel one timer, re-open after a temporary interruption, and a redacted weather fixture without a live key.

Run the target-device probes for landscape fullscreen, hidden system panels, keep-screen-on, readability, temporary lifecycle/process interruption and the permitted/suppressed audio route; do not probe reboot recovery.
Record fresh redacted logs, screenshots or device notes under the selected protocol/evidence paths and leave the lifecycle decision to the owning scheduler or explicit operator.
evidence_required: [REQ-000] Meaningful RED is not applicable to this verification-only final gate because it changes no production behavior; accepted alternative proof is a fresh clean/reset execution of every build, start, test, smoke and compatibility check with redacted artifacts.

[.memory-bank/testing/runtime-verification.md#foundation-minimal-proof] Meaningful RED is not applicable for the same verification-only reason; GREEN is the complete minimal path with known initial state, safe rerun/reset, observable result and cleanup recorded in the protocol/evidence artifacts.

[.memory-bank/contracts/platform-runtime.md#display-runtime-boundary] Meaningful RED is not applicable because the gate does not alter display behavior; GREEN is fresh target-device evidence for landscape fullscreen, hidden system panels, keep-screen-on and readability.

[.memory-bank/contracts/platform-runtime.md#timer-and-audio-runtime-boundary] Meaningful RED is not applicable because the gate does not alter lifecycle/audio behavior; GREEN is fresh evidence for temporary interruption rehydration, visual overdue independence and permitted/suppressed audio behavior, excluding reboot recovery.

[.memory-bank/contracts/local-secret-handling.md#evidence-and-verification] Meaningful RED is not applicable because no credential-bearing production change occurs; GREEN is a synthetic/redacted artifact scan proving no real key appears in source, APK resources, logs or evidence.

T3 isolation, safe rerun, cleanup and permissions: reset disposable local state before and after the smoke path, use synthetic fixtures only, install only the generated debug APK on the authorized target/emulator, and do not grant new network, secret or production permissions.
purpose: Independently prove that the completed FT-000 walking skeleton satisfies the accepted Foundation exit criteria across clean build, launch, deterministic probes, smoke flow and target-runtime compatibility.
success_outcome: Fresh evidence proves one debug APK builds and installs, the app starts through the accepted composition root, the resettable smoke path remains usable, host probes pass, target-device compatibility probes pass or record an evidenced platform limitation without scope expansion, and no credential or speculative product behavior appears.
anti_goals: Do not implement or verify full FT-001–FT-009 product acceptance criteria.
Do not add reboot recovery, a backend, Google Services, a new provider, event infrastructure or extra runtime permissions.
Do not treat a live API key, live provider request or an unredacted artifact as a valid Foundation proof.

forbidden_scope: Product implementation beyond the FT-000 walking skeleton
backend, cloud sync, accounts, Google Services and reboot recovery
new permissions or external side effects beyond authorized install/start/probe execution
stop_conditions: Stop and route to /spec-design if a failed compatibility result requires changing architecture, ownership, source of truth, public boundary or Foundation scope.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks if a missing result is feature-level provider mapping, schema, UX or product behavior rather than Foundation proof.
Stop for operator direction if a target-device limitation would require reboot recovery, new permissions or a changed security posture.

constraints: Use only the implementation and probe surface established by TASK-001; the final gate is acceptance evidence, not a second implementation task.
Run every check from a known disposable/resettable state and preserve only redacted evidence.
A target-ROM limitation is recorded as runtime evidence and does not authorize reboot recovery, new permissions or product-scope expansion.
The final Foundation Gate must be done before any product task queue is created or executed.
invariants: .memory-bank/invariants.md#must: clock/timer/cache paths remain usable within the accepted Foundation smoke scope and secrets remain local/redacted.
.memory-bank/invariants.md#never: no reboot recovery, backend, Google Services, extra V1 scope or unredacted credential evidence.
.memory-bank/contracts/platform-runtime.md#compatibility-and-failure-rules: platform limitations are evidence, not a new product boundary.
.memory-bank/testing/runtime-verification.md#target-device-evidence: device checks cover only outcomes host-side checks cannot reliably prove.
verification_targets: REQ-000 / Foundation Exit Criteria: minimal path, compatibility probes and clean redacted evidence are complete; no unresolved material Foundation pressure remains.

.memory-bank/testing/runtime-verification.md#foundation-minimal-proof: build, launch, known initial state/reset, visible main-display smoke, deterministic timer probe, redacted fixture path and target-device route are all proven.
.memory-bank/contracts/platform-runtime.md#display-runtime-boundary: fullscreen, hidden panels, keep-screen-on and readability are proven on the target path.

.memory-bank/contracts/platform-runtime.md#timer-and-audio-runtime-boundary: temporary interruption rehydration and audio policy evidence preserve visual overdue behavior; reboot recovery remains excluded.
.memory-bank/contracts/local-secret-handling.md#evidence-and-verification: artifact scan is clean without ever introducing a real key.
